name: Frozen Codex v1.0.5
body:
## Frozen Codex v1.0.5

Changes since v1.0.4:

### Use in-game Ace Lord Day 1 values
From in-game screenshots of Ace Lord (1/7) Heroes Assemble:
- Phases: 15,000 / 30,000 / 60,000 / 120,000 / 300,000 / 600,000 with the
  shown rewards (phase 6: 2x Hero Choice Card)
- Bag Hoard Day 1 points: Timeless Scroll 20,000, Deluxe Ticket 10,000,
  5/4/3-star Omni Hero Shard 30,000/10,000/3,000, 2-star Hero Shard 750,
  Bond Gifts T1-T5 75/375/750/9,375/18,750; Choice/Realm cards give 0
- Bag Hoard marks values confirmed in-game; other days stay estimates
- Events revision 2 and SEED_VERSION 5 so installed apps pick it up

### Automatic patch notes on every release
- Each release now lists every change since the previous release
- Each change shows its title and details; internal attribution lines are left out
- Notes include install instructions and the build's commit

### Event calendar matches the in-game schedule
Checked against the in-game Event Schedule for the week of 23 Nov:
- Scorching Front now runs Saturday to Monday
- Shadow Expedition: sign-up from Sunday to Monday, then runs through the week
- Oblivion War now starts on Wednesday
- Timeless Heroes Recruitment now ends on Monday
- New: Resource Supply and Holystone Upgrades (Monday to Sunday)

### Alliance Party, Undead Scourge and Elemental Seal days fixed
From the in-game Event Schedule:
- Alliance Party is now Tuesday and Friday (was Wednesday and Sunday)
- Undead Scourge is now on the calendar: Tuesday and Thursday, 00:00-23:50 UTC, in Ace Lord weeks
- Elemental Seal: I on Thursday, II on Friday, III on Saturday
- Rewards shown in-game added to these events

---
Install: download the APK below and open it on your phone (it updates the existing app).
Built from commit fad66fa.
